findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "estimate_job" is 676 chars, far longer than this server's median (97). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job_result · Private data: upload_asset · Public sink: submit_remotion_render, submit_ffmpeg_job, submit_h3_clip, upload_asset · Destructive: remove_background.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job_result · Private data: upload_asset · Public sink: submit_remotion_render, submit_ffmpeg_job, submit_h3_clip, upload_asset · Destructive: remove_background

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
